verdicts.reason: A: the RSVP CTA has been shrunk to badge size and jammed into a 2x2 pill cluster in the top-right corner next to the logo. 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' has dropped below the body copy, which breaks the reading order. The headline is right-aligned while the copy under it is centred, and the legal line is microscopic. B: the RSVP CTA is buried as a tiny pill in a bottom row of badges, so it has no hierarchy at all. A red missing-asset placeholder sits in the middle of the text column. 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' is again below the copy and centred under left-aligned text, and the bottom-left is cramped while the area around the product is empty. A is less broken.
